responses.value: I'd look at the cost to win each student, content production, instructor payouts, and platform costs. I'd start with marketing spend per new student by channel for two years, since growth bought with marketing can cost more than it brings in.
Instructor payouts. Revenue grew 20% but profit fell, so if marketing per student held, another cost grew faster.
